derived_notes: p0 deliberately does NOT claim A, C, F, D, V, S, U, Sv39 or any cache; docs/implementation-plan.md#1.1 lists these as forbidden early claims.
Two clusters exist in p0 because the execution fabric (I-022..I-032) is in scope for the p0 gate; clusters are an internal structure and are not architectural state.
